notes.title: Small Update - 1.03.06
notes.notes:
Hello, here's the list of changes for this small update:

 The "sociology" notion has been changed to "demographic group" in English, Spanish and Polish.
 The German version is now available as a beta test. If you want to test it, join our Discord to get the password. (https://discord.gg/AWdvAe4m)
 Some minor corrections

notes.title: Small update - 1.03.05.b
notes.notes:
Hello ! Here's the list of the main changes for this update:

Steam successes are now implemented.
The bug that caused debates to stop has now been fixed.
The AI will get less good cards in the middle and end of the game.
Some national flags have been corrected. More changes to come.

notes.title: Vox Populi: Europa 2024 - Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
The political strategy game 'Vox Populi: Europa 2024' is now released!

Here's a reminder of the main features that differ from the other games in the series:
A new mechanism of laws and referendums to be organised during the campaign
Seven scenarios, including the 2024 European Union elections and many other futuristic fictional scenarios
Unique combinations of ideologies and Corpus, linked to dozens of new European and national flags.
A new system of political paths specific to Europe, allowing players to navigate between Europeanism, Socialism and Sovereignism

A new Discord where we can communicate directly with each other has also just opened: https://discord.gg/NTP48dJR

The game is available in English, French, Spanish and Polish. German and Italian versions will be available soon.

See you soon!
